operative_clauses.original_operative_text:
Section 1. Order of Succession. Subject to the provisions of section 2 of 
this order, and to the limitations set forth in the Act, the following officials 
of the Office of the National Cyber Director, in the order listed, shall act 
as and perform the functions and duties of the office of the National Cyber 
Director (Director) during any period in which the Director has died, resigned, 
or otherwise become unable to perform the functions and duties of the 
office of Director: 
(a) Deputy National Cyber Director; 
(b) Chief of Staff; 
(c) Assistant National Cyber Director for Policy Development; 
(d) Assistant National Cyber Director for Policy Implementation; 
(e) Assistant National Cyber Director for Resource Management and Admin-
istration; and 
(f) General Counsel.

operative_clauses.original_operative_text:
Sec. 2. Exceptions. (a) No individual who is serving in an office listed 
in section 1(a)–(f) of this order in an acting capacity shall, by virtue of 
so serving, act as Director pursuant to this order. 
(b) No individual who is serving in an office listed in section 1(a)– 
(f) of this order shall act as Director unless that individual is otherwise 
eligible to so serve under the Act. 
(c) Notwithstanding the provisions of this order, the President retains 
discretion, to the extent permitted by law, to depart from this order in 
designating an acting Director.

operative_clauses.original_operative_text:
Sec. 3. General Provisions. (a) Nothing in this order shall be construed 
to impair or otherwise affect: 
(i) the authority granted by law to an executive department or agency, 
or the head thereof; or 
(ii) the functions of the Director of the Office of Management and Budget 
relating to budgetary, administrative, or legislative proposals. 
(b) This order shall be implemented consistent with applicable law and 
subject to the availability of appropriations.

research_rationale: Full saved official derivative of EO14139, all numbered sections, compared with EO14148 section 2 express enumeration and section 4 savings. The prospective succession list and its interpretive limitations cease as this order's directive upon express revocation January20,2025. This order contains no predecessor-revocation or amendment provision. Independent statutes and already taken actions are separated from prospective EO authority. This claim intentionally leaves material custody, counterevidence and where applicable completed-consequence questions open; it is not ready for human review. Counterevidence reviewed: the three undated saved-text hits are copies of the January 3, 2025 original itself. The actual U.S. Code mention at 5 U.S.C. 3345 note, Office of the National Cyber Director, states that EO14139 was revoked by EO14148 section 2(ooo) on January 20, 2025; it is an editorial revocation-status note confirming cessation. This assessment adopts the exact three bounded machine-search scopes, including the explicit October 9 U.S. Code boundary, eCFR as of October 14, and the OFR catalog and saved-text scan. Source custody and the stated statutory-coverage limitation remain open.

savings_residuals.reason: Sections 2 and 3 preserve limits imposed by the Federal Vacancies Reform Act and independent statutory authority. EO14148 revokes this specific succession directive; it does not repeal those independent statutes or itself invalidate prior actions. No independent continuing EO-created succession directive is identified in the original.
